title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit Examiner Notes: Paper Claims Overlapping an Earlier Network Fill
content:
**Rule.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the overlap of a paper claim is the days of the member's most recent paid network claim for the same drug that had not yet run out on the receipt's date of service, counting that claim's date of service as day zero. The refill threshold of that claim is its days supply multiplied by the network's refill fraction for a controlled substance when the drug is a controlled substance, and by the network's refill fraction for other drugs for any other drug.

- When the receipt's date of service came before that refill threshold, the whole overlap is taken off the reimbursed days of the paper claim.
- When it came on or after the refill threshold and the overlap exceeds the network's accumulation limit, only the overlap beyond that limit is taken off.
- Otherwise nothing is taken off, and nothing is taken off when the member has no paid network claim for the drug.

The overlap is taken off the reimbursed days once those days are settled, and the allowed amount and the member cost share are then worked out on the days that remain.

## Figures by network

| Network | Refill fraction, drug not controlled | Refill fraction, controlled substance | Accumulation limit (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Performance Network | 0.8 | 0.9 | 7 |
| Northbridge Essential Network | 0.8 | 0.9 | 7 |
| Northbridge National Network | 0.75 | 0.85 | 10 |
| Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | 0.75 | 0.85 | 10 |
| Northbridge Retail90 Network | 0.75 | 0.85 | 15 |
| Northbridge Open Choice Network | 0.75 | 0.85 | 15 |

The controlled substance on these networks is oxycodone-acetaminophen.

## Examiner questions and answers (hypothetical claims)

**How are the days counted?** The days elapsed are the calendar days from the network claim's date of service (day zero) to the receipt's date of service. The overlap is the network claim's days supply less the days elapsed, never below zero. The receipt "came before" the refill threshold when the days elapsed are fewer than the threshold figure, which is not rounded.

**Northbridge Essential Network; network claim of 30 days on day 0; 30-day receipt dated day 20.** The threshold is 30 multiplied by 0.8, that is 24. Twenty days elapsed is before it, so the whole overlap of 10 days is taken off: 30 reimbursed days become 20.

**Same network; receipt dated day 25.** Twenty-five days is on or after 24. The overlap is 5 days, which does not exceed 7, so nothing is taken off.

**Northbridge Retail90 Network; network claim of 90 days on day 0; 30-day receipt dated day 70.** The threshold is 67.5. Seventy days is after it. The overlap is 20 days, which exceeds 15, so the 5 days beyond 15 are taken off: 30 reimbursed days become 25.

**Northbridge National Network; oxycodone-acetaminophen network claim of 10 days on day 0; receipt dated day 8.** The threshold is 10 multiplied by 0.85, that is 8.5. Eight days is before it, so the whole overlap of 2 days is taken off.

**No paid network claim for the drug.** There is no overlap, and nothing is taken off.
